  (hf.contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)

    norm_num
  have hh := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) (he.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ))

  (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hs (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
